title: Denoise postprocess policy
content: Denoise is not automatic by default. Recommend denoise only when residual noise, color noise, block noise, or enhanced-noise increase is detected. Execute only after confirmation unless automatic mode is explicitly enabled. Re-score denoised output and rollback if quality drops.

title: Super-resolution postprocess policy
content: Super-resolution is not automatic by default. Recommend it only when the user asks for enlargement, the input is low resolution, or downstream use needs larger output. Re-score SR output and rollback if artifacts, amplified noise, or lower score appear.

title: NAFNet boundary
content: NAFNet is experimental/manual denoising only. It must not participate in default V2 automatic enhancement candidate planning or compete with Retinexformer, DarkIR, HVI-CIDNet, FLOL, and SCI as a main enhancement model.
